scripts.build: node -e "console.error('❌ FATAL: Bare build command disallowed. Specify npm run build:prod or npm run build:staging.'); process.exit(1);"
scripts.build:staging: node scripts/validate-staging-config.js && vite build --mode staging && node scripts/audit-staging-bundle.js
scripts.build:prod: node scripts/validate-config.js && vite build --mode production && node scripts/audit-bundle.js --strict
